name: SOVB 3D
summary: French filament brand (SOVB3D) selling PLA in about 30 colours and ABS in about 24 colours, plus a glow-in-the-dark ABS, on 1 kg 1.75 mm spools. Very little public company information; the manufacturer and legal entity are unknown.

product_lines.name: Fil PLA
product_lines.notes: About 30 colours; 1 kg, 1.75 mm; brand states 190-230 C nozzle while SimplyPrint lists 180-200 C.

product_lines.name: Glow ABS
product_lines.notes: Single glow-in-the-dark colour. Mapped to abs because the catalog has no glow-ABS id.

additional_notes: Not related to Sovol (the similar name is search noise). Only an aggregator listing was read; no imprint or legal entity found. No OEM relationship was found either way, so oem_relationships is empty. No price evidence, so price_tier is omitted. SpoolmanDB PR #454 contains only 3 products.

provenance.conflicts: Nozzle temperature range disagrees between the brand listing (190-230 C) and SimplyPrint (180-200 C). City, legal entity and manufacturing origin unverified.
